2124665790360129978.en_summary: That is exactly the test. If falling energy prices flow through PPI, CPI and eventually core PCE, while FCF estimates remain intact, the market will have priced a 2022-style margin squeeze that never arrived. Combine that with completed deleveraging and crowded shorts, and yes, the setup for a violent rally would exist. The key distinction is disinflation versus demand destruction. Lower inflation with stable growth is bullish. Lower inflation because demand is collapsing is not. Watch core inflation, earnings estimates and credit together. That will tell us which one we are getting.
2124665790360129978.zh_summary: 這正是測試。如果能源價格下跌傳導至PPI、CPI最終核心PCE，而自由現金流估計保持完整，市場將已定價一種從未到來的2022式利潤率擠壓。結合完成的去槓桿和擁擠的空頭，是的，暴力反彈的設置將存在。關鍵區別是通縮與需求破壞。較低通脹配合穩定增長是看多的。因為需求崩潰導致的較低通脹則不是。一起觀察核心通脹、盈利估計和信用。那將告訴我們得到的是哪一種。

2124665734559093020.en_summary: Over the last 10 years, the Duchenne community, more than any rare disease group, has weaponized patient advocacy to pressure the FDA to approve ineffective drugs under the guise of regulatory flexibility. The underlying motivation is understandable — a desire to treat a devastating disease. But billions of dollars have been spent on treatments for Duchenne, a majority of them made by the biotech company Sarepta Therapeutics, even when clinical trials prove they don’t work.
2124665734559093020.zh_summary: 過去10年，Duchenne社區比任何罕見疾病群體都更多地將患者倡議武器化，以監管靈活性為幌子向FDA施壓批准無效藥物。潛在動機可以理解——渴望治療毀滅性疾病。但數十億美元已花費在Duchenne治療上，其中大多數由生物科技公司Sarepta Therapeutics製造，即使臨床試驗證明它們不起作用。

ticker_notes.SRPT: Billions spent on ineffective Duchenne treatments despite failed trials
